A fresh-session residue postcheck is mandatory even when the harness aborts.
RBAC prerequisite tables are asserted and never mutated by the harness.
The remediation migration and five runtime files remain byte-identical.
Clean replay, exact-name history verification, harness assertions, residue verification, tests, typecheck and production build are binding gates.
Commit B may begin only after Commit A evidence is pinned.
Commit C may begin only after Commit B evidence is pinned.
Pass 3.8.3 remains NOT STARTED until terminal governance formally closes Pass 3.8.2.

separate_findings.title: private.fn_handle_new_auth_user inserts into public.organizations without tenant_id
separate_findings.description: The new-user trigger inserts into public.organizations (name, slug, created_by, updated_by) only. A later migration made public.organizations.tenant_id NOT NULL, so any trigger-enabled auth.users insert aborts with 23502: null value in column "tenant_id" of relation "organizations" violates not-null constraint.
separate_findings.reproduction: Clean replay of the 31-migration chain, then a single trigger-enabled auth.users insert inside a transaction; the insert fails at private.fn_handle_new_auth_user() line 38 with SQLSTATE 23502 and the transaction rolls back.
separate_findings.workaround_in_harness: The certification harness sets session_replication_role = replica (SET LOCAL) for its single synthetic auth.users insert and restores origin immediately; the residue postcheck asserts no leakage.
separate_findings.disposition: Referred to the Architecture Office as a separate remediation item requiring triage. It is not repaired under MIG-20260726-GATE38-PASS382-HISTORY-REPAIR and does not block the Commit A pin.
